newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-SHERINGHAM LIKELY TO MISS ITALY MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SHERINGHAM LIKELY TO MISS ITALY MATCH.

text.p: Tottenham Hotspur striker Teddy Sheringham is almost certain to miss England's vital World Cup qualifier against Italy next month after limping out of a training session on Monday with a nagging ankle injury.
Sheringham, who scored in England's last match in Georgia, was testing the strength of his ankle for the first time since damaging it in training three weeks ago.
But he failed to complete the session and now appears unlikely to face Italy at Wembley on February 12.
England manager Glenn Hoddle is due to name his squad on Thursday.
